title: [host-failure-line] hostFailureLine: host failure line that keeps the error cause code
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add function `hostFailureLine(message: string, causeCode: string): string` to `src/host-failure-line.ts` returning causeCode.length === 0 ? "MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED:" + message : "MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED:" + message + ":cause=" + causeCode
- hostFailureLine("fetch failed", "ECONNRESET") is "MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED:fetch failed:cause=ECONNRESET"
- hostFailureLine("fetch failed", "") is "MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED:fetch failed"
- hostFailureLine("R2_GET_500", "") is "MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED:R2_GET_500"
- hostFailureLine("", "UND_ERR_SOCKET") is "MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED::cause=UND_ERR_SOCKET"

(Builder pre-file, ADD_FUNCTION, public-add-function-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). Every scheduled scan since 2026-10-14 ends with only MARKETS_SCHEDULER_HOST_FAILED:fetch failed because src/host.ts main().catch drops error.cause; this is the line the host will print once wired, with the cause code (never a URL) appended when there is one. Production safety: one new pure function in a new module plus one new src/*.test.ts file only: nothing imports it yet, so the running scanner, the scan and the ten-minute chain are unchanged. Wiring it in is a separate task that needs a skill PeaceAI does not have yet (see batch-v4/scanner/DIAGNOSIS.md). Job B grades it against itself: the new test passes with the function and fails with the source put back. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1e8448a, live 30-rule approved list, Node 20) built exactly one candidate (public-add-function-v2); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes with the function and fails with its body stubbed); suite 599/599, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new module and test file. Expected COUNTS.)
